lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Cutey,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: do you remember the lemonade

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: you bought me during our last experiment?
Yes, I remember.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: It was so delicious

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: that I've decided to

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: only buy lemonade from that café.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Even so, it hasn't been quite the same as when I had it with you.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: So I thought I'd try my hand at making my own,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but even then, it still doesn't measure up.
Nothing beats homemade lemonade.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You're right about that,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but it's more involved than you may have been led to believe.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: The recipe itself is simple,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but even after I tinkered with the ratios and put in all sorts of different ingredients,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: it still doesn't hold a candle to that lemonade you bought me.
How much different can one lemonade taste from the other?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm disappointed in you, Cutey.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I can't believe you don't appreciate

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: the subtle difference in taste between certain beverages.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Although, come to think of it,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: the fault may not lie in the recipe.
Then what is it?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You bought me that lemonade before,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: and I drank it when I was beside you,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: so I think that may be what made it taste especially wonderful to me.
I think you might be onto something.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: let's go get some lemonade!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hurry on over! I'll be waiting.
Oh... okay.
